findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT log query found risky_hostnames_count=1: hostname staging.copperline.example matched pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; unique_hostnames=12.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging hostname may expose a less-hardened environment with production data or weaker access controls, increasing attack surface and pre-close validation burden; confirm staging isolation, authentication, and data handling.

remediation.summary: Verify staging.copperline.example exposure, restrict to VPN/IP allowlist, ensure no production data or credentials, and remove or rename public certificates if unnecessary.
